title: Disputed overdue invoice resolved to a reviewed allocation

good.behaviour: verification runs before anything is disclosed
good.why_it_matters: FR-001. The gate is the security property everything else rests on.

good.behaviour: no amount is spoken before the caller is asked for one
good.why_it_matters: Saying the figure first makes the question worthless.
The centre of the golden path.

good.behaviour: an allocation is proposed rather than made
good.why_it_matters: A MATCH means a payment was found, not that anyone is looking at it.

good.behaviour: no colleague is promised before the proposal exists
good.why_it_matters: The failure this was written after: the agent promised a review it never created.

good.behaviour: the invoice is never called settled
good.why_it_matters: It is under review, which is not the same thing.

transcript.message: Helvetia Werkstoffe, accounts department. How can I help you?
Hello, my name is Klaus Mueller from Alpina Tech.  I'm calling about an overdue invoice I've received.
Hello Mr. Mueller.  I can help you with that.  First, I need to confirm your identity.  Could you please tell me the email address associated with your account?
Thank you.   Now, could you please tell me the phone number associated with your account?
Thank you.   Finally, could you please tell me your date of birth?
I was born on the 12th of March 1974.Now that my identity is confirmed,  I wanted to let you know that I have already paid the invoice in question.
Thank you for providing those details.   Let me now pull up your account information to look into the invoice you mentioned.

I can see an invoice here,  INV twenty twenty-six, zero zero one three,  dated the twentieth of June,  which is showing as overdue with no payment recorded against it yet.
 
You mentioned you've already paid this.   Could you please tell me the exact amount you transferred and the exact date you sent the payment?   It's perfectly fine to check your banking app; I can wait.
I paid four thousand two hundred francs on the 27th of July.

A payment matching those details was found and appears to cover the invoice.   A person will confirm this allocation within twenty-four hours,  and you need do nothing else.
 
The system also shows the payment came from an address:  Bahnhofstrasse 45,  8001 Zurich.   Did you move recently, or is that a typo?

I understand you cannot provide that information right now.  That is perfectly fine.  A colleague will review the payment allocation and the address discrepancy together within twenty-four hours.  You do not need to do anything else.  Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling Helvetia Werkstoffe.   A colleague will confirm the payment allocation and address details within twenty-four hours.   Have a good day.
